div.head: IV Atr 7.2
div.ab: Et habeat postea dampnum illud ex incuria sua, ut cambiat ab institutis monetariis purum et recte appendens.
Et habeat postea dampnum illud ex incuria sua, ut cambiat ab institutis monetariis purum et recte appendens.
Und [dieser Kaufmann] trage danach infolge seiner Unachtsamkeit den Schaden, dass er von den angestellten Münzern reines und vollwichtiges Geld [gegen sein mangelhaftes] einwechseln muss.
And let [this merchant] afterwards bear the loss resulting from his carelessness, in that he must exchange [his defective money] for pure money of full weight from the appointed moneyers.
And afterwards such a trader shall pay the penalty of his carelessness by having to change [his base money] for pure money of the proper weight obtained from the authorised moneyers.
